claims.evidence: Witness only saw a generic front headlight assembly; no readable brand/model/part number or vehicle-compatibility markings were captured.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy.
claims.evidence: No clear, readable part number/label or branding on the headlamp housing was shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: The report does not include close-up condition checks for cracks/chips, or confirmation that all mounting clips/brackets are intact.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (Honda Accord 2003/2007 vs actual vehicle side/model), leading to unusable purchase.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of any part number/label on the headlight housing (and the connector/wiring side), plus a shot showing the exact mounting/tab layout.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used headlamp of unknown fitment/side (buyer assumes return/fitment risk).

risks.risk: Aftermarket/clone vs genuine part; branding/part number not readable in the provided report.
risks.proof: Clear, readable OEM markings/part number (sticker/engraving) on the lens housing and/or back cover, photographed straight-on.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or poor condition (hairline cracks, chips, lens cloudiness, moisture/condensation inside, broken internal retainers).
risks.proof: Multiple close-ups: lens surface (front), edges, and a view of the inside/reflector area (or back opening) showing no moisture and intact internal components.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/uncertain condition (worst-case: not guaranteed clear/fully functional).

risks.risk: Missing or non-working components (bulb/ballast/igniter, wiring harness/connector issues).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (bulb/ballast/igniter if present) and a clear shot of the connector type; if possible, a short clip showing it powered on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as headlamp only, with functionality not guaranteed.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the headlight housing part number/label (front and back) so fitment can be confirmed.
Confirm which side it is (left or right) with a photo showing the mounting orientation and tabs/clips.
Provide close-up photos of the lens edges and the full lens surface to check for cracks/chips/cloudiness.
Show the inside of the headlamp (reflector/inside view) to confirm no moisture/condensation.
Show what is included (bulb/ballast/igniter/wiring harness/connector) and a powered-on video if possible.
response.reason: The witness can confirm it is a front headlight assembly, but key pricing drivers—exact vehicle compatibility, OEM vs aftermarket, and true condition—are not verifiable from the report. Proof is needed before a reliable worst-case price can be set.
